title: API Versioning
description: Implement API versioning to support multiple versions of the same API.

data.text: Implement API versioning to support multiple versions of the same API.
**Scenario:** Configure or implement the described functionality in an ASP.NET Core application.
Include the version in the URL path like /api/v1/products and /api/v2/products.

data.title: URL Path Versioning

data.text: Pass version as a query parameter like /api/products?api-version=1.0.
